name: claude-desktop-mods
description: Mods for the Claude desktop app's Code tab: sidebar status sections, a usage band and an Environment pane.

scripts.test: for m in chat-status usage-band environment-pane; do claude plugin test plugins/$m || exit 1; done
scripts.validate: claude plugin validate . && for m in chat-status usage-band environment-pane; do claude plugin validate plugins/$m || exit 1; done
